fusions.name: Gaff and Drag
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed link at the first enemy it meets that deals 12 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, then hauls you 6 tiles toward it.

fusions.name: Barbed Round-Up
fusions.desc: Sweeps a ring of barbed links around you that deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauling Swing
fusions.desc: Swings you 6 tiles forward on a chain, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Tally
fusions.desc: Each hit you land on an enemy builds a stack on it, up to 5. At 5 stacks they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack, 170% in all. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
